1.prompt: A student says Europeans first traded with India only after Suez opened. Correct the claim using the medieval network,1498 and 1869.

This established a new direct maritime route for the Portuguese to India within already active Indian Ocean networks. Compass and astrolabe aided navigation; gunpowder supported armed maritime expansion.
The Suez Canal opened in 1869, linking the Mediterranean and Red Seas.
